EX-99.1 2 vnda8-k10282026exhibit991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Vanda Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results • Q3 2026 Total Revenues increased 24% to $69.8 million compared to Q3 2025 and 38% compared to Q2 2026 • Q3 2026 Total Operating Expenses decreased by 18% to $93.3 million compared to Q2 2026 • Announced positive results from the Phase III study of NEREUS™ for prevention of GLP-1-induced vomiting • NEREUS™ for prevention of vomiting induced by motion became commercially available in Q2 2026 • BYSANTI TM commercial launch expected in Q4 2026 • Quimilza TM BLA for GPP under review by the FDA; PDUFA target action date of December 12, 2026 WASHINGTON – October 28, 2026 – Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc.

“Looking ahead, with the commercial launch of BYSANTI expected in the fourth quarter, the Quimilza BLA under FDA review with a December PDUFA date, and positive Phase III results supporting potential expansions for NEREUS in GLP-1-induced vomiting and HETLIOZ in Delayed Sleep-Wake Phase Disorder, we are focused on further moderating costs and driving revenue growth from our current portfolio and planned launches to support sustainable long-term value.” Financial Highlights Operating Expenses • During 2025 and 2026, Vanda has advanced multiple Phase III programs, continued its commercial activities for Fanapt ® (iloperidone), HETLIOZ ® (tasimelteon) and PONVORY ® (ponesimod) and prepared for the commercial launches, including manufacturing commercial supplies, of NEREUS TM (tradipitant), BYSANTI TM (milsaperidone), and Quimilza TM (imsidolimab).
• In September 2026, Vanda announced positive topline results from the pivotal Phase III study of HETLIOZ ® in adults with Delayed Sleep-Wake Phase Disorder (DSWPD).
Vanda intends to discuss these data with the FDA and to submit an sNDA seeking approval of HETLIOZ ® for DSWPD.

• The Biologics License Application (BLA) for Quimilza™ in Generalized Pustular Psoriasis (GPP) is under review by the FDA with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of December 12, 2026.

Important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those reflected in Vanda’s forward-looking statements include, among others, Vanda’s ability to continue to grow its business; Vanda’s ability to successfully execute the commercial launch of BYSANTI™ for the treatments of bipolar I disorder and schizophrenia in Q4 2026; Vanda’s ability to successfully launch and commercialize its recently approved products and any product that may be approved in the future; Vanda’s ability to continue to reduce its operating expenses; the FDA’s ability to complete its review of, and reach a decision with respect to, the BLA for Quimilza™ by December 12, 2026; the FDA’s willingness to meet with Vanda to discuss the NEREUS™ Phase III clinical study results and Vanda’s ability to gain alignment with the FDA on the regulatory path for NEREUS™ and submit an sNDA for NEREUS™ for the prevention of vomiting associated with GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy; the FDA’s willingness to meet with Vanda to discuss the HETLIOZ ® Phase III clinical study results and Vanda’s ability to gain alignment with the FDA on the regulatory path for HETLIOZ ® in the treatment of DSWPD and to obtain regulatory approval of HETLIOZ ® for this indication; Vanda’s ability to meet its enrollment target for, and complete, the Phase III study for BYSANTI™ for the treatment of MDD and receive results in the first half of 2027; and the outcomes of the administrative hearing process for HETLIOZ ® for the treatment of jet lag disorder and the court cases for HETLIOZ ® for the treatment of insomnia and NEREUS™ for the treatment of gastroparesis.
